name: Coach! Oshiete
source:
New teacher was suddenly invited to a girls' school as an advisor to the athletics division. The final goal is to win the tournament! Is it possible to train six champions?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
新教師突然被邀請到女子學校擔任體育社的指導老師。最終目標是贏得比賽！他能訓練出六名冠軍嗎？
